response.sql:
WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(INVOICE.[DATE_]), MONTH(INVOICE.[DATE_]), 1) AS ay, CLCARD.[DEFINITION_] AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE -INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] END) AS net_satis_tutar FROM (SELECT '211' AS [__nb_firm], [CANCELLED], [CLIENTREF], [DATE_], [NETTOTAL], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_01_INVOICE] UNION ALL SELECT '411' AS [__nb_firm], [CANCELLED], [CLIENTREF], [DATE_], [NETTOTAL], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE]) AS INVOICE LEFT JOIN (SELECT '211' AS [__nb_firm], [DEFINITION_], [LOGICALREF] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_CLCARD] UNION ALL SELECT '411' AS [__nb_firm], [DEFINITION_], [LOGICALREF] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_CLCARD]) AS CLCARD ON INVOICE.[CLIENTREF] = CLCARD.[LOGICALREF] AND INVOICE.[__nb_firm] = CLCARD.[__nb_firm] WHERE INVOICE.[CANCELLED] = 0 AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9) AND INVOICE.[DATE_] >= '2025-12-01' AND INVOICE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(INVOICE.[DATE_]), MONTH(INVOICE.[DATE_]), 1), CLCARD.[DEFINITION_])
SELECT c.[ay], c.[muster], c.[net_satis_tutar],
 DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.[ay] ORDER BY c.[net_satis_tutar] DESC) AS aylik_sira,
 p.[net_satis_tutar] AS onceki_ay,
 100.0 * (c.[net_satis_tutar] - p.[net_satis_tutar]) / NULLIF(ABS(p.[net_satis_tutar]), 0) AS yuzde_degisim
FROM monthly c LEFT JOIN monthly p
 ON (c.[muster] = p.[muster] OR (c.[muster] IS NULL AND p.[muster] IS NULL))
 AND p.[ay] = DATEADD(month, -1, c.[ay])
WHERE c.[ay] >= '2026-01-01' AND c.[ay] < '2027-01-01'
ORDER BY c.[ay], aylik_sira, c.[muster]
